dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you, then. *sigh* How could something like this happen...

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: I can't just leave everyone else in town to fend for themselves, or I'd be up a gander back to the ruins to investigate... Still, it's a good thing I ran into you!

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: Hello. We meet again. To be honest, seeing you once more makes me wonder if I'm still in a dream...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you been busy with lately?

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: Since that incident, I've discovered that hypnosis is indeed a most promising research direction.

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: Just think about it! In a dream, all your fantasies could easily come true, could they not?

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: As such, I've read the notes Grispan left behind. I'm not sure I'll do better than him, but I can at least add to the field.

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: He's sure to be impressed when he returns!

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: Most definitely. Despite his tender age, he's a brave little kitty. Shockingly bold, even.

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: He's utterly unafraid of strangers. I'm sure he'd get along with everyone in town smashingly.

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: See you. Do come and see Osse more often. I'm sure he misses you.
